answer: Agents bond stake and evaluate an epoch polynomial, committing each Semaphore identity to a rate-limit secret. A zero-knowledge proof binds each message to its polynomial share and nullifier without exposing the secret. Sending distinct messages that reuse an epoch nullifier exposes two shares; interpolation recovers the RLN secret, permitting attribution and instantaneous collateral slashing—not necessarily disclosure of the signing private key. Delta rules, a zenith quorum, and ferrous audit records support accountable Sybil resistance.
